Requirement: Implementations **SHALL** support all [US Quality Core profiles](profiles.html).
Not Tested Details: Individual profile tests exist, but complete support for all profiles has not been established; generator exclusions and optional groups remain.

Requirement: Implementations **SHALL** support all elements flagged as USCDI+ Quality.
Implementations **SHALL** support all elements flagged MustSupport in underlying US Core profiles.
Server implementations **SHALL** support the requirements described in the [US Quality Core Server CapabilityStatement](CapabilityStatement-us-quality-core-server.html).
Not Tested Details: Umbrella requirement; individual REST and declaration tests do not establish all CapabilityStatement obligations.

Requirement: Server implementations **SHALL** support all interactions, search parameters, and combined search parameters that have `SHALL` conformance expectations in the US Quality Core Server CapabilityStatement.
Server implementations **SHALL** declare their support of the US Quality Core profiles in a FHIR CapabilityStatement.
Not Tested Details: Existing tests do not verify that the server CapabilityStatement declares support for all applicable US Quality Core profiles.

Requirement: Quality improvement applications **SHALL** recognize and process all MustSupport elements in US Quality Core.
Not Tested Details: Client request observation does not demonstrate recognition and processing of MustSupport data.

Requirement: Modifier elements **SHALL** be treated as MustSupport, even if not explicitly declared.
Not Tested Details: Modifiers may be covered incidentally; metadata does not systematically include every isModifier element.

Requirement: Applications **SHALL NOT** process resource instances that include unknown modifier elements.
Not Tested Details: Requires observable client rejection or non-processing of unknown modifiers; not established by resource validation.

Requirement: If a target resource referenced by a US Quality Core profile has a US Quality Core profile, it **SHALL** conform to the US Quality Core profile.
Not Tested Details: Explicit target-profile references are tested, but generic and inherited references are not universally checked against Quality profiles.

Requirement: Quality improvement applications **SHALL** be simultaneously compliant with US Quality Core profiles and US Core profiles.
Not Tested Details: Instance validation provides structural evidence, not application-wide compliance with both guides.

Requirement: Where a US Quality Core profile is derived from a US Core profile, the more restrictive bindings defined by US Quality Core **SHALL** be applied where they exist.
Not Tested Details: Existing profile validation tests are not mapped until the applicable bindings that tighten US Core constraints and their validation coverage have been reviewed.

Requirement: Applications **SHOULD** use the preferred value sets as defined by US Quality Core profiles.
Not Tested Details: Preferred bindings are recommendations; code membership does not establish application preference.
